watch.summary: The streamer confidently boasts that he was 'born to catch' a floating ball in Rocket League, only to immediately whiff and get scored on, causing him to fall off his chair screaming.

beats.what: Streamer takes control of the play, declaring 'it's all me now'.
Streamer boasts 'I was born to catch this' while positioning under the ball.
He whiffs completely and the opponent scores.
Streamer screams loudly and falls backward out of his chair.
Streamer climbs back into frame laughing hysterically at his own failure.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I was born to catch this
watch.why: The instant karma timing between his bold boast 'I was born to catch this' and his immediate whiff creates a flawless hubris-fail joke. His dramatic scream and disappearing off-camera add great physical comedy to the moment.
